FAQ

What does a toner do and why should I use one?

Toner (also known as ‘facial tonic’ or ‘facial water’) is the final step in your cleansing routine. It refreshes and revitalises your skin, purifies pores, removes any remaining traces of cleanser, and prepares your skin for the next phase of your skincare routine.

Why does Eucerin DERMOPURE CLINICAL Purifying Toner contain alcohol?

Alcohol is a powerful ingredient known for its ability to kill bacteria, reduce excess sebum, and leave skin feeling cool and refreshed with an astringent effect. The alcohol concentration in this toner is carefully balanced to be effective without drying out the skin.

I’ve been using Eucerin DERMOPURE CLINICAL Purifying Toner for several days but I still have spots. What am I doing wrong?

Eucerin DERMOPURE CLINICAL Purifying Toner can help blemish-prone skin recover, but patience is key. Skin renewal takes around 28 days, so results won’t be instant. The more impurities in your skin, the longer it may take to see improvements. Stick to your daily cleansing and care routine for at least eight weeks, and you’ll start to notice the benefits.     Gentle Exfoliating Toner
    I trust Eucerin products as they are known for being kind to skin, so I did not have any concerns with this trial. It is easy to use and comes in a good sized bottle. The product does not cause any irritation, stinging or sensitivity, which can be a concern with exfoliating toners. I liked using the product to replace my own toner, but I did not notice its effect on my skin. It didn't dry out my skin, as it promises, which is definitely a plus. However, the claims to unclog pores or refine skin texture were not apparent for me. As always with skincare, everyone is different, so it may be amazing for someone else. The main thing is that it didn't do any harm, so I'll probably continue using it until it finishes.
